functions.name: format_display_value
functions.signature: (value: Any, *, prefix: str='', suffix: str='', tipcfg: Optional[dict]=None, key: Optional[str]=None, label: Optional[str]=None)
functions.doc:
Build the user-visible caption for a dropdown item.

This function:
  1) Normalizes inputs (value → str, tipcfg → dict, collect tip prefix/suffix).
  2) Resolves the effective prefix: explicit `prefix` or `tipcfg['caption_prefix']`.
  3) Resolves the effective suffix with correct precedence:
        a) explicit `suffix` (highest priority), otherwise
        b) `tipcfg['caption_suffix']`, otherwise
        c) auto-units (if numeric, no known unit at end, and tipcfg['units'] exists).
  4) Composes "prefix + value + final_suffix" and trims whitespace.

Parameters
----------
value : Any
    Item value (e.g., "50", "0.25", "High", "50 Hz").
prefix : str
    Explicit prefix placed before the value (e.g., "f=").
suffix : str
    Explicit suffix placed after the value (e.g., " Hz"). If present,
    units will NOT be auto-appended.
tipcfg : dict | None
    Tooltip/config dictionary that may include:
      • caption_prefix : str
      • caption_suffix : str
      • units          : str  (e.g., "Hz", "dB", "µV")
key : str | None
    Unused: accepted for API parity with upstream callers/tests.
label : str | None
    Unused: accepted for API parity with upstream callers/tests.

Returns
-------
str
    Final display string (prefix + value + final_suffix).

Examples
--------
>>> format_display_value(50, tipcfg={"units": "Hz"})
'50 Hz'
>>> format_display_value(50, suffix=" Hz", tipcfg={"units": "dB"})
'50 Hz'
>>> format_display_value("50 Hz", tipcfg={"units": "Hz"})
'50 Hz'
>>> format_display_value("50", tipcfg={"caption_suffix": " samples/sec", "units": "Hz"})
'50 samples/sec'

#------------------------ 1. Normalize inputs --------------------------------------
#------------------------ 2. Resolve effective prefix ------------------------------
#------------------------ 3. Resolve effective suffix (suffix > caption_suffix > units)
#------------------------ 4. Compose & trim ----------------------------------------
functions.purpose: Build the user-visible caption for a dropdown item
